$comment: uBO Lite, the ad blocker built into Mergelane's browser extension (ADR-0063). Its official release builds are fetched at build time by scripts/adblock/ubol.mjs, checked against these SHA-256s, and merged into the extension; nothing of it is committed. sourceUrl is the gorhill/uBlock commit those builds were made from (uBOL-home's uBlock submodule at the release tag), attached to every Mergelane release by scripts/media-tools/sources.mjs. To update: pick a uBOL-home release, take the .chromium.zip and .firefox.signed.xpi digests from its release page, and the uBlock submodule commit at its tag.
